name: zotero-research-synthesis
description: Synthesize bounded Zotero literature into traceable research context. Use when a user needs evidence-backed topic, claim, graph, gap, or cross-source synthesis for a current question.

prompts.common: Treat SKILL.md as the authoritative procedure and use the bundled zotero-bridge-cli Skill for exact commands. Return exactly one final JSON object with __SKILL_DONE__: true plus schema, status, summary, optional evidence, artifacts, and diagnostics matching assets/output.schema.json. Return __SKILL_DONE__: false only while a concrete user decision is required.
